## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix JSON argument parsing because a following option is consumed as its destination, breaking the default JSON output alongside JUnit. This review read both changed files and all available tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds an optional JSON destination, defaults it to `results.json`, and introduces report writing with parser and file-output tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following options when JSON uses its default — For `["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"]`, your parser consumes `--junit` as the JSON destination and then raises `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")`. Both destination selection and argument advancement check only whether another token exists, unlike the JUnit branch's option-prefix check. — Users cannot request default JSON output before a valid JUnit option; report generation fails. — Fix: Consume the next token only when it is a path rather than another option, and add a regression test for this ordering.
